about: Destroy with Godzilla! Protect with Mothra! Fight with King Dhidorah! Rampage with all monsters!
Actions with upmost destructive special effects will further evolve with PS4™!
This is the trial version with the most destructions and special effects for all Godzilla fans. Control monsters to destroy all the streets, weapons, and other monsters.
All appearing monsters will be controllable! So will you become the God of destruction by controlling Godzilla? Or become the savior for humans by controlling Mothra?
There will be several brand new features including teaming up with humans and go on defense missions in protecting the streets!
Get in involved with the 3 greatest battles—including the fight from the silver screen of course—to experience the dream battle like never before!
You can also fight with rivals around the world from global online fights as well. So become the world's No.1 "True Monster King"!
